file_status: DRAFT v0.1 - enum NAMES are FROZEN (plan section 0.4); integer values are PROVISIONAL until CP2

values.name: NORMAL
values.label: Normal
values.description: Monitoring. A +60 min risk raises an information alert only.

values.name: PREDICTIVE_WARMING
values.label: Predictive warming
values.description: Entered from a forecast; after entry, dose comes from T_est feedback only. Simulated, clinician-supervised.

values.name: ACTIVE_WARMING
values.label: Active warming
values.description: T_est below t_hypo, or target lost.

values.name: TARGET_MAINTENANCE
values.label: Target maintenance
values.description: Holding near target; heating may reach 0.

values.name: CLINICIAN_WARMING
values.label: Clinician warming
values.description: Clinician pressed START; regulation is automatic.

values.name: TWIN_DEGRADED
values.label: Twin degraded
values.description: Twin unreliable; monitoring only (or fixed clinician demand in CLINICIAN_FIXED).

values.name: SAFETY_SHUTDOWN
values.label: Safety shutdown
values.description: System fault; all heating 0; latched until Clinician_Reset.

values.name: NONE
values.description: Not in TWIN_DEGRADED.

values.name: MONITOR
values.label: Monitor only
values.description: Twin unreliable; alert only; no autonomous warming.

values.name: CLINICIAN_FIXED
values.label: Clinician fixed demand
values.description: Twin unreliable but the clinician has started warming; fixed demand, still module-limited.

values.name: NO_DATA
values.label: No data
values.description: No observation yet.

values.name: INITIALISING
values.label: Initialising
values.description: tau < 20 min since settled start.

values.name: VALID
values.label: Valid
values.description: Twin outputs usable.

values.name: DEGRADED
values.label: Degraded
values.description: Twin unreliable (missing data or high state uncertainty).

values.label: Real development data
values.description: Development-set VitalDB observation. Never the final holdout.

values.label: NERAM twin model output
values.description: Produced by the robust state-space twin.

values.label: Simulated
values.description: Produced by a simulation, stand-in or test bench.

values.label: Assumed
values.description: Depends on an assumed (not learned) relationship, e.g. the warming response.

values.label: Open loop
values.description: Controller commands do not affect the observed signal.

values.label: Twin stand-in loop
values.description: Closed-loop test with a twin stand-in; not the Digital Twin.

values.label: Twin in the loop
values.description: Summit version: twin receives the ASSUMED warming input.
